newsitem.title: JAPAN: Decision on Japan extra budget seen after Sept 20.
newsitem.headline: Decision on Japan extra budget seen after Sept 20.

text.p: Japan's government is set to make a decision on whether to draft an extra budget after September 20, following the release of gross domestic product (GDP) data later this month, a ruling coalition official said on Monday.

Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto and Finance Minister Wataru Kubo agreed on Sunday that the government should decide on whether to draft an extra budget for 1996/97 to stimulate the economy after seeing GDP data for the April to June period, the coalition official said.
Hashimoto and Kubo also agreed that a final decision on the extra budget should be made sometime after September 20, the official said.
